title: Relation-attribute factorized R-GCN Mirror views
hypothesis: A shared relation-transform basis plus a multiplicative Mirror coordinate composed from two semantic relation attributes will predict held-out attribute combinations with lower serialized inference bytes than per-relation R-GCN basis coefficients, while remaining within 10% of their seen-relation MSE.
physical_object: Shared relation transform basis matrices in a one-layer R-GCN message operator.
mirror_coordinate: m(a,b) = tanh(U[a]) elementwise-multiplied by tanh(V[b]), then linearly decoded to shared-basis coefficients.
logical_multiplicity: One logical relation transform for each ordered pair of relation attributes, including held-out pairs.

random_selection.selection_rule: registry rows priority=P0 AND status=UNTESTED; exclude every ID with any remote research/ma-* branch; numeric ID order

controls: Independent full relation transforms (upper control; seen relations only)
Native R-GCN basis with free per-relation coefficients (seen-relation control)
Additive relation-attribute factorized coefficients (simple compositional control)

development.selection_metric: mean held-out-combination MSE; tie break by serialized inference bytes
development.allowed_tuning: Mirror/additive rank in {2,4,8} and equal optimizer update budget in {150,600}; choose the lowest-compute setting meeting the held-out and seen-quality gate. All methods receive the same selected update budget.

fresh.selection_metric: MSE on held-out attribute combinations and seen relation held-out examples

data.generator: Synthetic relation-conditioned linear message operator. Four values for each of two semantic relation attributes; 16 ordered pairs, with pairs (0,0),(1,2),(2,3),(3,1) excluded from training and development fit. Inputs/outputs and true relation coefficients generated per world seed.

paid_objects: all model buffers and inference metadata
storage.marginal_state_comparison: Report whole inference payload bytes and actual serialized marginal relation-code payload bytes separately. Shared basis is common state; the relation coefficient table or attribute factor tables plus coefficient decoder are serialized as independent marginal payloads. No parameter-count proxy.

compute.report_active_compute_proxy: counted multiply-adds in forward/backward and inference; estimate labeled as proxy

success_gate: On all three fresh worlds, Mirror held-out-combination MSE is at least 20% below additive control and within 10% of free per-relation basis control on seen combinations; serialized Mirror coordinate state (excluding the shared basis common to all methods) is at most 60% of native free coefficient-table state; complete serialized payload is smaller than the free-coefficient model. Runtime is separate.
failure_gate: Mirror fails if it does not improve on additive factorization on held-out combinations, or exceeds the quality tolerance on seen combinations, or its actual bytes do not beat the free per-relation coefficient model.
boundaries: Synthetic mechanism screen only; no real KG/link-prediction claim.
Mirror coordinates do not count as independent relation capacity.
If ordinary additive factors match, no Mirror-specific claim.
Fresh results cannot change selected rank or any protocol setting.

amendments.reason: Clarified the storage denominator: full payload includes a basis shared by every compared method, so the code-compression gate applies to the separately serialized marginal relation-coordinate payload; full payload remains reported and compared.
amendments.protocol_effect: No model, data, optimizer, selection, or quality threshold change.

amendments.after: initial development-only screen, before fresh access
amendments.reason: The rank-2 Mirror point showed a large held-out gain but missed seen-relation quality at 150 updates; distinguish optimization undertraining from representational failure using a predeclared equal-budget 600-update dev option.
amendments.protocol_effect: Development may select 150 or 600 updates, equally for every method. Fresh inherits the selected rank and update count. No quality thresholds or fresh seeds changed.

selection_gate: Development selects the lowest update count then rank that meets both: Mirror seen-relation MSE <= 1.10x native basis MSE, and Mirror held-out-combination MSE <= 0.80x additive-factor MSE. If no candidate meets both, freeze the dev candidate with lowest held-out MSE and classify the development screen as a gate failure; do not open fresh.
